text:
Priya: Heads-up — seeing a spike in structured_output.rejects for function hooks on a few production routes. Error shows up as 'unexpected_type' when adapters return numbers instead of objects. Anyone grabbed the raw logs yet?

Ari: Which routes? websearch? chat-assist?

Priya: Mostly chat-assist and a couple of third-party connector routes. Paste from logs: `error: structured_output.reject code=unexpected_type path=/result.value got=number want=object sample_id=abc123`

Sam: deploy-bot just posted the same alert a minute ago. Looks correlated with yesterday's strict-validate rollout (canary slice=5%).

deploy-bot: [alert] rule=structured_output.reject threshold=50m window=5m routes=[chat-assist, connector-x] count=87 :rotating_light:

Nate: If strict-validate is causing rejects, that affects billing metrics (rejects currently counted as failing calls). We need to avoid surprise chargebacks for customers.

Ari: Agreed. Options: 1) pause strict-validate rollout, 2) switch those routes to soft-validate (log-only) with higher sampling, 3) add adapter coercion heuristics (coerce number->object where safe).

Priya: I'm leaning to soft-validate for the affected routes so production traffic keeps flowing and we collect examples. We should also tag the telemetry with `validation.mode=soft` so the console can show which rejects are real vs logged.

Sam: Console change: add a filter in the Structured Output dashboard to show `validation.mode` and a toggle to view sample payloads (with PII redaction). I can prototype quick UI: show 50 examples per route with anonymized values.

Nate: Also want a billing note: if we soft-validate we shouldn't surface these as billable rejects. Add a flag on the event `chargeable=false` for soft-validate sampled rejects. Ops/finance expects a short RFC before we ship.

Priya: I'll draft an RFC. For immediate mitigation: Ari, can you flip the canary back to permissive mode for the two routes? Sam, can you add telemetry tagging so we can split metrics? Nate, I'll coordinate the billing flag with finance.

Ari: On it. Rolling strict-validate -> permissive on chat-assist/connector-x now (canary slice -> 0). ETA 2m.

Sam: Will add `validation.mode=permissive` or `soft` tags to the existing metric pipeline and create a console filter. I'll also enable a 10% sampler that captures full payloads (scrubbed).

Priya: Thanks. Follow-ups: - RFC for billing/chargeable semantics - small console UX for `validation.mode` toggle - longer-term: adapter coercion rules + unit tests in gateway - add automatic example collection flow for regressions

Nate: Add me to the RFC review and please ping finance with sample counts. We should avoid retrospective credits.

Priya: Will do. Closing thread when RFC link and deploy confirmations are in.

Ari: deployment done — permissive mode active. counts should stabilize.

deploy-bot: [deploy] service=validation-gate change=mode->permissive routes=[chat-assist, connector-x] status=success ts=1798765452

Sam: Telemetry tag pushed; console filter scaffolded (PR incoming). Also stored 90 scrubbed examples for the team to inspect.

Priya: Great work everyone. Leaving a follow-up card in the eng-platform board for the RFC and UX tasks. :thumbsup:
